name: perfectvector-monorepo
description: AI-assisted raster to clean SVG vectorization service, engine and MCP plugin

scripts.build:web: pnpm run fixtures && pnpm run samples && pnpm --filter @perfectvector/web build
scripts.build:static: pnpm run fixtures && pnpm run samples && pnpm --filter @perfectvector/web build:static
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:web
scripts.pack: pnpm --filter @perfectvector/core exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../tmp/pack && pnpm --filter @perfectvector/mcp exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../tmp/pack
scripts.//verify:all: Builds each web target immediately before verifying it. Both builds write to apps/web/.next, so without a fixed order the server run depends on whichever happened to run last.
scripts.verify:all: pnpm run verify && pnpm run verify:strokes && pnpm run verify:real && pnpm run verify:mcp && pnpm run verify:batch && pnpm run verify:package && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:web && pnpm run build:static && pnpm run verify:web:static && pnpm run verify:vercel && pnpm run verify:docker
scripts.//typecheck: The engine is consumed through its built declarations (core's types field points at dist), so both the MCP server and the web app need it compiled before they can be checked. Without this a clean checkout reports the engine's exports as implicitly any, which is what CI hit.
